# Maternity ward beds

!!! info "Definition"
    A maternity ward bed is a hospital bed used for the ongoing care, treatment, recovery and overnight stay of pregnant or postnatal patients admitted for maternity care.

## Activity classification

A maternity spell may require capacity for assessment, delivery and postnatal care, across different functional areas. This calculation estimates maternity ward bed requirements, accounting for workload allocated to birthing rooms.

Activity includes maternity spells with a recorded birth event, grouped into:

* Normal delivery
* Assisted delivery
* Elective C-section
* Non-elective C-section

Overnight maternity spells without a recorded birth event are also included.

**Workload deductions:** **Normal delivery, Assisted delivery, Non-elective C-section:** Allocated workload from [Maternity birthing rooms](maternity-birthing-rooms.md).

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

For each birth subgroup, convert zero-day spells into bed-days using the assumed zero-day length of stay.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Zero-day bed-days}
    =
    \text{Zero-day birth spells}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Zero-day length of stay (minutes)}}{1{,}440}
    $$

Add these to overnight bed-days for birth spells, then deduct time allocated to birthing rooms to avoid double-counting.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    \text{Birth-related ward bed-days}
    &= \text{Birth spell overnight bed-days} \\
    &\quad + \text{Zero-day bed-days} \\
    &\quad - \text{Birth-room bed-days}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

For maternity spells without a recorded birth event, use the overnight bed-days directly. Zero-day spells without a birth event are modelled under maternity assessment beds.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{No-birth ward bed-days}
    =
    \text{No-birth spell overnight bed-days}
    $$

Sum birth-related and no-birth ward bed-days to obtain the total maternity ward workload.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    \text{Total ward bed-days}
    &= \text{Birth-related ward bed-days} \\
    &\quad + \text{No-birth ward bed-days}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of maternity ward beds by dividing total ward bed-days by the product of the service's annual operating days and the assumed occupancy rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required maternity ward beds} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Total ward bed-days}}
    {\text{Annual operational days} \times \text{Occupancy rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal delivery | Length of stay | Pathway |
| All groups | Occupancy rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational days | Operational |
| Assisted delivery | Length of stay | Pathway |
| Elective C-section | Length of stay | Pathway |
| Non-elective C-section | Length of stay | Pathway |


??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `NORMAL_DELIVERY_MATERNITY_WARD_BEDS`
    * `ASSISTED_DELIVERY_MATERNITY_WARD_BEDS`
    * `ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_MATERNITY_WARD_BEDS`
    * `NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_MATERNITY_WARD_BEDS`
    * `NO_BIRTH_MATERNITY_WARD_BEDS`

    **Conversion archetype:** bed occupancy · `FRM_BED_OCCUPANCY`

    **Operational constraint:** continuous occupancy over 24-hour operational periods

    **Workload object:** `bed_days`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | Normal delivery | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_NORMAL`) |
    | Assisted delivery | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_ASSISTED`) |
    | Elective C-section | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION`) |
    | Non-elective C-section | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION`) |
    | No birth event | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_NO_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_NON_ZERO_LOS`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_MATERNITY` | Maternity admissions | (admimeth starts with 3 OR tretspef IN (501, 560)) AND sex = "2" AND age BETWEEN 13 AND 55 |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` | Birth event recorded | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_NORMAL` | R24 normal delivery | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_ASSISTED` | R19 breech extraction or R20 other breech or R21 forceps cephalic or R22 vacuum or R23 cephalic vaginal w. abnormal present. head | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION` | R17 elective caesarean | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION` | R18 other caesarean | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_NO_BIRTH_EVENT` | No birth event recorded | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_NON_ZERO_LOS` | Spells with an overnight stay | speldur > 0 |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_MATERNITY`: See the Demand Model definition of maternity activity: https://connect.strategyunitwm.nhs.uk/nhp/project_information/data_extraction/inpatients.html#group

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | Normal delivery | `MATERNITY_WARD_NORMAL_DELIVERY_ZERO_DAY_LOS` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_WARD_OCC` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_WARD_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_DAYS` |
    | Assisted delivery | `MATERNITY_WARD_ASSISTED_DELIVERY_ZERO_DAY_LOS` |
    | Elective C-section | `MATERNITY_WARD_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_ZERO_DAY_LOS` |
    | Non-elective C-section | `MATERNITY_WARD_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION_ZERO_DAY_LOS` |

    **Workload deductions**

    | Subgroup | Functional-area IDs |
    | --- | --- |
    | Normal delivery | `MATERNITY_BIRTHING_ROOMS` |
    | Assisted delivery | `MATERNITY_BIRTHING_ROOMS` |
    | Non-elective C-section | `MATERNITY_BIRTHING_ROOMS` |
